entries.origin: Pose reference generated by the character stage (prompt docs/skins/monogatari_watcher-art/prompts/pose-merchant.txt, identity from the approved idle); no new API call.
entries.method: The model output (1024x1536, native alpha, no fully opaque pixels because of a baked glow in the colour of the fully transparent area) is cleaned deterministically: alpha below 24 dropped, detached specks under 600 px removed, edge colour taken from 2 px inside the figure. The tight crop (4 px margin) is the lossless source.

entries.origin: Front idle pose (approved identity, scripts/art/sources/monogatari_watcher-char/idle-identity.webp lineage) flattened onto neutral grey and scaled to 683x1024.

entries.method: Reference sheet = hand-watcher.webp and grip-watcher.webp upscaled to the 512x1536 columns the model sees (inverse of the exporter), flattened on grey. Output cleaned like the merchant cutout; the left arm is shifted 8 px left so its wide sleeve stays inside its 512 px column, and the right column is cleared of the left arm overflow. Hand silhouettes match the reference registration (top rows 42/146 versus 44/147).
